note: Train-fit only — run_suite.sh pins train==val==test to the same 2 tasks (traces_parsec-aap2-0047, traces_parsec-aap2-0048), so this is not a generalization/held-out claim. best=seed: cand_0001 (mean 0.225) and cand_0002 (mean 0.157) both scored well below the seed's own baseline measurement (0.317) and were rejected by the paired-SE gate, so reward_base and reward_opt here are two separate n=30 measurements of the byte-identical seed skill (baseline vs. finalize pass), not a comparison against an accepted candidate — the +0.009 delta is seed-measurement noise, not an improvement. n=30 trials/task, and these are 2 of the source experiment's 30 tasks; the other 28 are baseline-only and most of their trajectory scores are a harness artifact (2 of 4 simulators down during that sweep), not a skill measurement — see results/v1/summary.md on parsec-history for the full per-task history, cost breakdown, and data-quality caveats.
